title: Geographic constraint graph for ten Concordia worlds
honesty: Atlas kilometres and Hub metres are copied. Spoke and Sere disc radii are design_intent_disc. Sector offsets inside a disc are design_intent unless coordinates is null. countries.json claim circles are not borders. Resource quantity is always null. population_bias.relative is a within-world rank, not a census.

megaworld_km.axes: +x east toward Cyber (gate angle 0), +z north toward the Sundering (gate angle π/2)
megaworld_km.note: Present metres are the jog. travel_minutes on trade_graph are atlas time, not that jog.

local_claim_metres.note: countries.json circles of about 18–28 local metres overlap and are claims. Fluxom Gate (62, 18) m and the Ruins envoy pin (63.86, -9.91) m live here. Do not promote them into megaworld_km.

seas.inner_veil: Shoal in the ring marches where a coast exists, especially Tunya–Sundering and the Iron Coast river lane.
seas.exodus_ocean: Basin outside the Canon Ring on the southwest-to-south arc. Sere sits in it. Crime–Sere is the short strait. Frontier–Sere is the long ocean. Ark Exodus is lore, not a ninth spoke.

integration.today: One Poughkeepsie heightmap. Fixed seed 0xc0ffee for every world. hashSeed(worldId) is reserved and not applied to the rendered grid.
integration.g0_extends: Per-world terrain_affinity classes and forbidden landforms for a future continental field beside this profile.
integration.do_not: Replace the rendered formula or treat seedForWorldId as live.

integration.g0_extends: No new deformation. Digs stay on the local grid.
integration.do_not: Reintroduce a sine approximation of Hub geography.

integration.do_not: Ship a second flow solver or a river through the Hub plaza.

integration.today: 3–5 NPCs per procgen region plus a Living Society settlements row. Not a city physicalizer.
integration.g0_extends: Named hearts and population ordinals a later suitability pass can choose among.

integration.today: Routes and borders. Hub territories are empty by design.

integration.today: Local building and tree placement. hashSeed is the shared string seed.
integration.do_not: Author new kits or meshes in G0.

constraints.reject: Any region, settlement, or kit named Vinewood.
A second fantasy continent. world_id Fantasy displays as the Sundering.
Flower Law as a kilometre disk, or steel that stays steel inside the 42 m Hub disk outside the arena sand.
A Hub territory polygon. Districts are rings. WorldGeography Hub territories stay empty.
A river capital or fantasy channel through the Hub plaza. Civic drain and brass mouth only.
A mountain inside the Hub metro. Vertical play is metres of awning and bracket.
A Link door, a ninth Refusal, or a flowering blade on Sere. Waystone is a mark.
Promoting countries.json 18–28 m circles into megaworld kingdoms.
Inventing kilometres for fallback Tunya names, unplaced sites, the Last Dome mile, or Sere political capitals.
A placed mesa or an energy dome on the Frontier.
Lake country in the Sundering. One shelf waterfall and a short clear run.
A forum lake or a lava tube in Sovereign Ruins.
A pastoral river on the Grid. Alleys drain. Harbor is the Uncounted Wharf march.
A finished road on the Crucible–Grid seam. Kind stays weak.
A ninth district or a closed capital in the Crucible.
A victory statue as the Dawn heart.
A fourth blend kit where marches meet. Weathering crosses; kits stay distinct.
A tonnage, grade, or spawn rate on a resource locus in this graph.
Retuning world-terrain.js seed 0xc0ffee in G0 or pretending hashSeed(worldId) already drives the rendered grid.
